_readme: 'console' = DEV/TEST ONLY: writes OTP to otp-outbox.log (no internet needed).
PRODUCTION: set provider to 'twilio' and provide credentials via environment variables TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID, TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN, TWILIO_FROM (recommended) or fill the twilio block below.
'webhook' posts {phone, code} JSON to webhook_url - use with any local SMS gateway.
Internet is required ONLY when sending OTPs. Everything else stays offline.
